title: Sum of Consecutive Subsequences
summary: Given an array of integers, calculate the sum of the values of all consecutive non-empty subsequences, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given an array of integers, calculate the sum of the values of all consecutive non-empty subsequences, modulo 10^9 + 7. An array is consecutive if the difference between each pair of adjacent elements is either 1 or -1. An array of length 1 is also considered consecutive.
constraints: A nonempty subsequence is consecutive when all adjacent differences are +1 or all are -1; singletons qualify.
Return the sum of element sums over all such index subsequences modulo 1,000,000,007.
reference_solution:
def sum_consecutive_subsequence_values(nums):
    modulo=10**9+7;inc_count={};inc_sum={};dec_count={};dec_sum={};answer=0
    for value in nums:
        up_count=1+inc_count.get(value-1,0);up_sum=value*up_count+inc_sum.get(value-1,0)
        down_count=1+dec_count.get(value+1,0);down_sum=value*down_count+dec_sum.get(value+1,0)
        answer=(answer+up_sum+down_sum-value)%modulo
        inc_count[value]=(inc_count.get(value,0)+up_count)%modulo;inc_sum[value]=(inc_sum.get(value,0)+up_sum)%modulo
        dec_count[value]=(dec_count.get(value,0)+down_count)%modulo;dec_sum[value]=(dec_sum.get(value,0)+down_sum)%modulo
    return answer
